verdict.rationale: A live probe shows docs.x.ai serves an llms.txt describing itself as the official SpaceXAI (xAI) developer documentation. The docs pages are themselves served as .md files, and a machine-readable openapi.json is available, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. The .md.md 404 is just a double-extension URL and does not undercut this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the llms.txt or markdown docs in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://docs.x.ai/llms.txt # SpaceXAI API Documentation
